# Vault

> A local-first document vault PWA built on @niclaslindstedt/oss-framework.
> Important documents and notes live on-device (IndexedDB), organised into
> categories, folders and cross-cutting tags. A built-in receipt/document
> scanner captures paper; on-device OCR (tesseract.js) writes a text sidecar
> per scanned document so search finds text INSIDE files. Storage backends:
> this device (default), a local folder (desktop), or Dropbox — the cloud
> copy is always AES-GCM encrypted, not optionally.

- App: https://vault.niclaslindstedt.se/
- Source: https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/vault
- Framework: https://github.com/niclaslindstedt/oss-framework

## Features

- Documents and notes with categories, folders inside categories, and tags
  that bind documents across folders and categories
- Built-in receipt/document scanner (camera capture)
- On-device OCR text sidecars — search inside scanned/binary documents
- Storage: on-device by default; local folder (desktop); encrypted Dropbox
- Installable offline PWA with update prompts
